title: The constructible well-order recursion uses the first membership stage instead of its parent.
details: Revision 2026-01-31, Theorem20.9 and Exercise20.10, printed/PDF p.88. rank_L(x) is defined as the least alpha with x in L_alpha, but the definition then compares formula/parameter codes over this same L_alpha. The purported recursive order on the parameters can therefore involve elements first appearing with x, and is not supplied by the earlier stages. Repair: for a new element use the least parent stage delta such that x is in Def(L_delta)=L_(delta+1); order its definition codes using the already constructed well-order of L_delta. Extend the existing stage order by the new elements, taking coherent unions at limits. The source exercise as written is not certified.
